title: Today’s Hearing: Trial or Job Interview?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 我们将于11月

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As the Senate
sentences.zh: 随着参议院

sentences.en: Judiciary Committee opens its hearing into allegations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh, at stake for both
sentences.zh: 司法委员会对其针对布雷特·卡瓦诺法官指控的听证会的召开，对双方而言

sentences.en: parties is the swing seat on an ideologically divided Supreme Court in the thick of a midterm
sentences.zh: 生死攸关的是在一个意识形态分裂的最高法院中的那个关键摇摆席位，而此时正值中期选举的白热化阶段

sentences.en: election battle over who will control Congress for the final two years of President Trump's term.
sentences.zh: ，争夺谁将控制特朗普总统任期最后两年的国会。

sentences.en: So what's the plan on each side?
sentences.zh: 那么双方的计划是什么？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月27日，星期四。

sentences.en: Peter Baker, how are Republicans on the Judiciary Committee approaching today's hearing?
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克，司法委员会的共和党人是如何看待今天的听证会的？

sentences.en: Well, the Republicans on the committee are looking at this basically through the eyes of a criminal type procedure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，委员会中的共和党人基本上是通过刑事诉讼程序的视角来看待这一事件的。

sentences.en: They're trying to basically make this an argument about fairness and due process rather than an argument about what
sentences.zh: 他们试图将这变成一场关于公平和正义程序的辩论，而不是争论卡瓦诺法官

sentences.en: Judge Kavanaugh might or might not have done.
sentences.zh: 可能做过或没有做过什么。

sentences.en: In other words, they believe that there should be a presumption of innocence due process the way there would be anybody brought to court on a criminal
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们认为应该像把任何人带上刑事法庭受审那样，享有无罪推定和正义程序，

sentences.en: charge, that unless you can prove these allegations against Judge Kavanaugh, he ought to be afforded the presumption that he's not guilty, that he didn't do these things.
sentences.zh: 除非你能证明这些针对卡瓦诺法官的指控，否则他应该被赋予他是无辜的、他没有做过这些事情的推定。

sentences.en: So they're thinking of it as a trial.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把这看作是一场审判。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What they're trying to say is this is a character assassination, a smear campaign that's not backed up by enough evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们试图说，这是一场人格暗杀、一场缺乏足够证据支持的污蔑运动。

sentences.en: No prosecutor would bring 36-year-old allegations like this to trial without witnesses who were there at the time or other evidence that would corroborate in a powerful way.
sentences.zh: 没有哪个检察官会把这种36年前的指控闹上法庭，却没有当时在场的证人或其他能以强有力方式进行佐证的证据。

sentences.en: And so they're trying to say that we shouldn't presume that Judge Kavanaugh did this simply because there is a witness saying it or even a credible witness.
sentences.zh: 因此他们试图说明，我们不应该仅仅因为有一个证人这么说，哪怕是一个可信的证人，就推定卡瓦诺法官做了这件事。

sentences.en: She may get up there and she may be very persuasive and their argument is going to be as persuasive as she is.
sentences.zh: 她走上台可能会非常有说服力，而他们的论点也将和她一样具有说服力。

sentences.en: We ought to give him the benefit of the doubt because she can't prove it as if she were proving it in a criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 我们应该给予他合理的怀疑利益，因为她无法像在刑事审判中那样证明它。

sentences.en: It's a real test of credibility.
sentences.zh: 这是对公信力的真正考验。

sentences.en: Does the judge seem more believable to people who watch the two of them back to back?
sentences.zh: 对于连续观看他们两人的观众来说，这位法官看起来更可信吗？

sentences.en: Or does his accuser,
sentences.zh: 还是他的原告，

sentences.en: Dr. Christine Blasey Ford seem more believable?
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特博士看起来更可信？
zh_words: 克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特

sentences.en: And since we don't have an FBI investigation or any other kind of witnesses appearing at the hearing, it really comes down to these two people.
sentences.zh: 由于我们没有 FBI 的调查，也没有任何其他种类的证人出席听证会，这实际上就归结为这两个人。

sentences.en: So to get around that, the Republicans in effect are saying, let's give the benefit of the doubt in effect to the accused.
sentences.zh: 因此为了绕过这一点，共和党人实际上是在说，把怀疑利益赋予被告。

sentences.en: That's an American value.
sentences.zh: 那是美国的价值观。

sentences.en: The presumption of innocence.
sentences.zh: 无罪推定。

sentences.en: The presumption of innocence.
sentences.zh: 无罪推定。

sentences.en: Of course, that's American value in criminal cases, not confirmation specifically.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是刑事案件中的美国价值观，而不是专门针对确认听证的。

sentences.en: But they're saying, let's apply that standard here in order to be fair.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，为了公平起见，让我们在这里也适用这一标准。

sentences.en: It's not fair to this man who spent a whole career studying and working in government and in politics and on the bench in the circuit court for 12 years to get to this point.
sentences.zh: 对于这个花了一生职业生涯在政府、政治以及巡回法庭上学习和工作了12年才走到这一步的男人来说，这不公平。

sentences.en: It's not fair to derail his career and his whole life if you cannot prove these charges are, in fact, real.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法证明这些指控确实属实，那么摧毁他的职业生涯和整个人生是不公平的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In other words, it's a he said, she said.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是各执一词。

sentences.en: But that is an uncomfortable idea with Anita Hill in our past and in this current moment.
sentences.zh: 但在经历了安妮塔·希尔事件以及当下，这是一个令人感到不安的想法。

sentences.en: But it's less uncomfortable if you reframe he said, she said as innocent until proven guilty.
sentences.zh: 但如果你把各执一词重新定义为未经证明即为无罪，那么这种不安感就会减少。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: Because in fact, in some ways, the burden in society generally has shifted in the last year, particularly from where it was back in the Anita Hill and Clarence
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，在某些方面，过去一年社会总体的举证责任已经发生了转移，尤其是与安妮塔·希尔和克拉伦斯

sentences.en: Thomas days.
sentences.zh: 托马斯时期相比。

sentences.en: Back then, in effect, it was up to Anita Hill, according to a lot of people, to prove that Clarence Thomas had done the things she said he did.
sentences.zh: 在那时，实际上，根据许多人的说法，要由安妮塔·希尔来证明克拉伦斯·托马斯做了她所说的那样的事情。

sentences.en: In this day and age, with the Me Too movement, with so many terrible cases coming to light, there is a natural presumption these days to say, we need to believe these accusers.
sentences.zh: 在当今时代，随着“我也是”运动的兴起，以及如此多的可怕案件大白于天下，如今有一种自然的假设，即我们需要相信这些原告。

sentences.en: We need to give them, in fact, the benefit of our understanding and not question them just because they've come forward.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们需要给予他们理解，而不是仅仅因为他们站出来就质疑他们。

sentences.en: They're courageous in coming forward and we need to make it possible for real victims to come and tell their stories.
sentences.zh: 他们站出来是勇敢的，我们需要让真正的受害者能够前来讲述他们的故事。

sentences.en: That presumption, in effect, therefore, works against Judge Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种假设实际上对卡瓦诺法官不利。

sentences.en: And so the Republicans, in stressing the idea of a criminal type standard, a presumption of innocence and a, you know, innocent until proven guilty
sentences.zh: 所以共和党人强调刑事类型的标准、无罪推定以及你知道的“未经证明即为无罪”

sentences.en: kind of approach, are trying to shift that burden back to the accuser.
sentences.zh: 这种方法，正试图把举证责任转回给原告。

sentences.en: So, Peter, who's actually on trial here then?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，到底谁才是这里受审的人呢？

sentences.en: In the Republicans' minds, is it Kavanaugh who's on trial or is it Dr. Blasey Ford?
sentences.zh: 在共和党人看来，受审的是卡瓦诺，还是布莱西·福特博士？

sentences.en: Well, in a way, almost everybody's on trial here in this experience.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，在这场经历中几乎所有人都在受审。

sentences.en: Obviously, you have
sentences.zh: 显然，你拥有

sentences.en: Judge Kavanaugh facing these very, very serious allegations, allegations that would be a crime if brought in a court of law.
sentences.zh: 面对这些非常、非常严重指控的卡瓦诺法官，这些指控如果放在法庭上将构成犯罪。

sentences.en: You have Dr. Blasey Ford whose credibility will be put on trial to some extent.
sentences.zh: 你有布莱西·福特博士，其公信力将在某种程度上受到审判。

sentences.en: And in fact, the Republicans have even hired a prosecutor to do the questioning for them so that they do not look like they are beating up on a victim of sexual assault the way
sentences.zh: 事实上，共和党人甚至聘请了一名检察官来替他们提问，这样他们就不会像1991年的安妮塔·希尔事件那样，看起来像是在殴打性侵受害者

sentences.en: Anita Hill looked in 1991.
sentences.zh: 阿妮塔·希尔在1991年看起来是这样的。

sentences.en: But even the senators, I think, in some ways are on trial.
sentences.zh: 但即使是参议员，我认为在某些方面也在受审。

sentences.en: They're on trial because of that 1991 experience and the court of public opinion.
sentences.zh: 他们因为1991年的那次经历和舆论法庭而正在接受审判。

sentences.en: We're right in the thick of a midterm election campaign.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于中期选举竞选活动的核心。

sentences.en: And how they handle this, how they approach this hearing could go a long way towards influencing the way voters think about senators from both parties.
sentences.zh: 他们如何处理这件事，如何对待这场听证会，将在很大程度上影响选民对两党参议员的看法。

sentences.en: And why are Republicans choosing to use a prosecutor exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么共和党人为什么选择使用检察官呢？

sentences.en: I get the part where that reinforces the idea that this is a trial.
sentences.zh: 我理解那部分强化了这是一场审判的概念。

sentences.en: That seems pretty straightforward.
sentences.zh: 这似乎相当直截了当。

sentences.en: But beyond the appearance of it feeling like a trial, what's the purpose of using an outside prosecutor?
sentences.zh: 但除了感觉像审判的外表之外，使用外部检察官的目的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, in this case, they've hired a prosecutor named Rachel Mitchell, who works in Arizona as a sex crimes prosecutor as an investigator for authorities there.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，他们聘请了一位名叫雷切尔·米切尔的检察官，她在亚利桑那州担任性犯罪检察官兼当地当局的调查员。

sentences.en: She's worked on a number of cases involving Catholic church, sex abuse allegations.
sentences.zh: 她参与过许多涉及天主教会性虐待指控的案件。

sentences.en: And her experience is bringing sex abusers, sex predators to justice.
sentences.zh: 她的经验是将性虐待者、性掠夺者绳之以法。

sentences.en: In this case, obviously, she's working for the side on the hearing that doesn't want to believe these allegations are true, that wants, in fact, to believe that they're not true.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件中，很明显，她为听证会上不希望相信这些指控属实、甚至希望相信它们不是真的那一方工作。

sentences.en: So they're using somebody who is as experienced as you could get in proving these types of allegations to, in effect, undercut them in this instance.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们使用了一个在证明这些类型指控方面最有经验的人，以便在这种情况下实际上削弱这些指控。

sentences.en: Who would know better than somebody whose professional career has been spent proving sex crimes if she were to come out of this saying, basically, that these are not proven?
sentences.zh: 如果她最终说这些指控没有得到证实，还有谁能比一个职业生涯都用来证明性犯罪的人更清楚呢？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That's really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这真的很迷人。

sentences.en: So they're bringing in a prosecutor who they'll say, if anyone can prove this, it's her.
sentences.zh: 所以他们引进了一位检察官，他们会说，如果有人能证明这一点，那就是她。

sentences.en: And they're banking on the idea that it cannot be proven.
sentences.zh: 他们押注于无法被证明这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it would seem, anyway, to give the argument to the public that this is a more credible conclusion because she's not, in fact, inclined to let sex predators off the hook.
sentences.zh: 而且无论如何，这似乎会向公众传达这样一个论点：这是一个更可信的结论，因为她事实上并不倾向于放过性掠夺者。

sentences.en: This is somebody who's made her life putting them in jail.
sentences.zh: 这是一个把他们送进监狱作为自己一生事业的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I guess the question we may not know the answer to, but I'm certainly curious about,
sentences.zh: 我想我们可能不知道答案，但我绝对很好奇的问题是，

sentences.en: is, did she say, for instance, look, I'm going to do my job, and my job is to get to the bottom of this.
sentences.zh: 她有没有说过，比如说，听着，我要做好我的工作，我的工作是查明真相。

sentences.en: And if the outcome of that is that Dr. Blasey Ford looks good and Judge Kavanaugh looks bad, I'm just doing my job.
sentences.zh: 如果结果是布莱西·福特博士看起来很好而卡瓦诺法官看起来很糟糕，那我只是在做我的工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a great question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, one we'll see a little bit better later today when we watch this, you know, how does she approach this?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，今天晚些时候当我们观看这个节目时，我们会更好地看到这一点，她将如何处理这件事？

sentences.en: Does she approach it as an advocate?
sentences.zh: 她是以辩护人的身份处理吗？

sentences.en: Or does she approach it as a neutral fact finder?
sentences.zh: 还是以中立的事实调查者身份处理？

sentences.en: We've got a professional whose role is not 100 percent defined yet.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个其角色尚未百分之百确定的专业人士。

sentences.en: She does work for the Republicans and not the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 她确实为共和党人工作，而不是民主党人。

sentences.en: So you sort of presume that she's taking their lead on the kinds of questions that they would like to ask, but we'll have to see.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以推测她会听从他们关于他们想问的问题的引导，但我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: So for this strategy to work for Republicans, what's Kavanaugh's part in it?
sentences.zh: 那么为了让这个策略对共和党人奏效，卡瓦诺在其中的角色是什么？

sentences.en: Well, Kavanaugh has a very tough challenge.
sentences.zh: 嗯，卡瓦诺面临着非常严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: When Clarence Thomas went before this committee way back in 1991, he expressed anger at the way he had been treated.
sentences.zh: 当克拉伦斯·托马斯在遥远的1991年出席这个委员会时，他对自己的对待方式表达了愤怒。

sentences.en: He said this is a high-tech lynching, but that's not considered to be a viable strategy anymore.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一场高科技林奇，但那不再被认为是一个可行的策略。

sentences.en: So his goal is to appear persuasive, maybe even indignant, but not angry and not accusatory toward Christine Blasey Ford.
sentences.zh: 所以他的目标是显得具有说服力，甚至可能有些愤慨，但不能愤怒，也不能对克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特带有指责意味。
zh_words: 克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特

sentences.en: And we saw sort of a dress rehearsal for this on Monday night on Fox News when he went on and gave an interview.
sentences.zh: 我们在周一晚上福克斯新闻上他接受采访时看到了这方面的彩排。

sentences.en: I am looking for a fair process, a process where I can defend my integrity and clear my name.
sentences.zh: 我正在寻找一个公平的程序，一个我可以捍卫自己的清白并洗清名誉的程序。

sentences.en: You could tell he had a few lines he was sticking with, he was rehearsed.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出他坚持了一些台词，他排练过了。

sentences.en: Again, just asking for a fair process.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，只是要求一个公平的程序。

sentences.en: He wanted to come back to the same phrases that he thought were the message he wanted to get across.
sentences.zh: 他想回到他认为是他想要传达的信息的那些相同短语中。

sentences.en: Again, again, just asking for a fair process.
sentences.zh: 再次，再次，只是要求一个公平的程序。

sentences.en: He wanted a fair process, he said 17 times.
sentences.zh: 他想要一个公平的程序，他说了17遍。

sentences.en: He said, I've always treated women with dignity and respect.
sentences.zh: 他说，我一直以尊严和尊重对待女性。

sentences.en: He always supports the dignity of women, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，他总是支持女性的尊严。

sentences.en: What I know is I've always treated women with dignity and respect.
sentences.zh: 我所知道的是，我一直以尊严和尊重对待女性。

sentences.en: Four times.
sentences.zh: 四次。

sentences.en: I've never sexually assaulted anyone.
sentences.zh: 我从未性侵过任何人。

sentences.en: He's never sexually assaulted anyone,
sentences.zh: 朗尼说，他从未性侵过任何人，

sentences.en: Lonnie said.
sentences.zh: 朗尼说。

sentences.en: Not in high school, not ever.
sentences.zh: 高中没有，什么时候都没有。

sentences.en: I've never sexually assaulted.
sentences.zh: 我从未进行过性侵犯。

sentences.en: I've never sexually assaulted anyone in high school.
sentences.zh: 我从未在高中性侵过任何人。

sentences.en: In high school or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 无论是高中还是其他时候。

sentences.en: Six times.
sentences.zh: 六次。

sentences.en: Wow, you counted.
sentences.zh: 哇，你数过了。

sentences.en: Yeah, because it came across as repetitive.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为听起来很重复。

sentences.en: And I think that's something they're a little worried about in this hearing.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是他的顾问们在这场听证会上有点担心的事情。

sentences.en: His advisors, and even President Trump wants him to be a little bit more forceful in his denial.
sentences.zh: 他的顾问，甚至特朗普总统都希望他在否认时表现得更有力一点。

sentences.en: You have to show, they think, a little indignation.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，你必须表现出一点愤慨。

sentences.en: If you were falsely accused, you would be upset about it.
sentences.zh: 如果你被虚假指控了，你会为此感到不安的。

sentences.en: So there's a real fine line between indignation and anger that might look accusing of the victim.
sentences.zh: 所以在愤慨与可能看起来是在指责受害者的愤怒之间，有一条非常微妙的界限。

sentences.en: He's planning to say in his opening statement that he doesn't question that something bad happened to Dr. Christine Blasey Ford.
sentences.zh: 他计划在开场白中说，他不怀疑克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特博士身上发生了糟糕的事情。
zh_words: 克里斯蒂娜·布莱西·福特

sentences.en: And he doesn't question her credibility.
sentences.zh: 他也不怀疑她的可信度。

sentences.en: He's simply saying it wasn't him.
sentences.zh: 他只是说那不是他。

sentences.en: And that's the fine line he's trying to walk here.
sentences.zh: 这就是他试图走的那条微妙的界限。

sentences.en: I have to say, Peter, as someone who watches a lot of congressional hearings and sometimes kind of loses track of what the point of them is.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，彼得，作为一个经常观看国会听证会、有时甚至摸不清重点在哪里的人，

sentences.en: There's something kind of brilliant about framing this as a trial.
sentences.zh: 将这定性为一场审判有一种绝妙之处。

sentences.en: Because trials, of course, and we're trained to think this way, are kind of easy and familiar to follow.
sentences.zh: 因为审判当然是，而且我们受过这种思维训练，很容易且熟悉地去追踪。

sentences.en: We know the point of it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它的意义。

sentences.en: And rather than an open exploration of decades-old allegations without being clear what happens at the end, you know, are you supposed to make a decision
sentences.zh: 与对长达数十年的指控进行公开探索却不清楚最终结果会怎样相比，你知道，你是应该根据感觉、直觉做出决定，审判为这件事提供了一个非常清晰的框架？

sentences.en: based on a feeling, a gut instinct, a trial gives a very clear framework to this thing?
sentences.zh: 我们是否证明了他做了这件事？

sentences.en: Have we proven that he did this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，没错。

sentences.en: Well, that's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在法律与秩序电视节目中长大的国家，对吧？

sentences.en: And this is a country that has been raised on law and order television shows, right?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你愿意的话，把这当作国会山版的法律与秩序，至少在共和党人希望将其塑造为的那样。

sentences.en: So consider this the law and order Capitol Hill edition, if you will, at least as the Republicans would like to frame it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道那是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: And we know how that works.
sentences.zh: 检察官站起来，他或她试图排除合理怀疑地证明某事。

sentences.en: A prosecutor gets up, he or she tries to prove something beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 如果我们哪怕有一丝不确定，那么这个系统就会强迫你默认对被告有利。

sentences.en: If we have even a shred of uncertainty, then you're obligated by the system to default in the benefit of the accused.
sentences.zh: 这才是正确的。

sentences.en: That's the standard that the Republicans would like to set here.
sentences.zh: 这就是共和党人希望在这里设定的标准。

sentences.en: But whether they're able to actually convince others of that standard or not is the open question.
sentences.zh: 但他们是否真的能说服其他人接受这个标准，还是个未知数。

sentences.en: Are people going to buy the idea that this should be conducted like a trial?
sentences.zh: 人们会买账这种应该像审判一样进行的说法吗？

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It was great talking to you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和您交谈。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of their reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问他们的所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而不需要输入信用卡，会怎么样？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请下载《

sentences.en: Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序，今天就可以免费访问30天。

sentences.en: Cheryl K.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔·K·

sentences.en: Stolberg, we just heard our colleague Peter Baker say that Republicans are approaching today's hearing like a trial, knowing how difficult an allegation like this is to prove.
sentences.zh: 斯托尔贝格，我们刚听到我们的同事彼得·贝克说，共和党人把今天的听证会当成一场审判来对待，他们知道像这样的指控有多难证明。

sentences.en: So how are
sentences.zh: 那么，

sentences.en: Democrats responding to that same challenge?
sentences.zh: 民主党人将如何应对同样的挑战？

sentences.en: So, Michael, Democrats are looking at this as more of a job interview.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，民主党人把这更看作是一场工作面试。

sentences.en: They say it's not a trial.
sentences.zh: 他们说这不是一场审判。

sentences.en: Well, it's simply a hearing to determine whether or not Judge Kavanaugh is fit for a lifetime appointment to the highest court in the land.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这只是一场听证会，旨在决定卡瓦诺法官是否有资格获得国家最高法院的终身任命。

sentences.en: And Cheryl, how will a job interview style format for this hearing be different from a trial setting?
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，这场听证会采用工作面试的模式，将与审判环境有何不同？

sentences.en: Well, so in a trial setting, you have a standard of proof, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，在审判环境中，你有一个举证标准，对吧？

sentences.en: Like Mitch McConnell said the other day, Judge Kavanaugh is entitled to the presumption of innocence.
sentences.zh: 就像米奇·麦康奈尔几天前说的，卡瓦诺法官享有无罪推定权。

sentences.en: Other Republicans have said that just because Christine Blasey Ford has made these allegations, if they wouldn't stand up in a
sentences.zh: 其他共和党人表示，仅仅因为克里斯汀·布拉西·福特提出了这些指控，如果它们经不起

sentences.en: court of law, they're not enough to keep Judge Kavanaugh off the bench.
sentences.zh: 法庭的考验，就不足以阻止卡瓦诺法官进入法官席。

sentences.en: But Democrats view it entirely differently.
sentences.zh: 但民主党人的看法完全不同。

sentences.en: They don't think that this needs to be a situation of beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这不需要达到排除合理怀疑的程度。

sentences.en: They just want to know what is his character?
sentences.zh: 他们只想知道他的品格如何？

sentences.en: Is he truthful?
sentences.zh: 他是否诚实？

sentences.en: Is he the kind of person who's deserving of this job, which, after all, is a privilege, not a right?
sentences.zh: 他是否是那种配得上这份工作的人，毕竟这份工作是一种特权，而不是权利？

sentences.en: And why do Democrats want to avoid that trial-like question, that burden of proof?
sentences.zh: 为什么民主党人想要避开那种类似审判的问题和举证责任？

sentences.en: Because if you're framing this as a trial, there really is no way that Judge Kavanaugh could emerge the loser.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你把这定性为审判，卡瓦诺法官确实没有输的可能。

sentences.en: It is going to be probably impossible for Christine Blasey Ford to prove that what she says happened, happened.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·布拉西·福特可能永远无法证明她所说发生过的事情确实发生过。

sentences.en: There are no other witnesses at this hearing tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天这场听证会上没有其他证人。

sentences.en: Others who were said to be in the House at the time have said they don't remember this.
sentences.zh: 据说当时在房子里的其他人已经表示他们不记得这回事了。

sentences.en: So it becomes kind of a he said, she said.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点变成了一场各执一词的争论。

sentences.en: And if it's a he said, she said in a legal sense, then Judge Kavanaugh gets acquitted, right?
sentences.zh: 如果从法律意义上讲是各执一词，那么卡瓦诺法官就会被判无罪，对吧？

sentences.en: So Democrats prefer a he said, she said in which there isn't the kind of technical legal burden of proving anything.
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人更倾向于这种不需要承担任何技术性法律举证责任的各执一词的局面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's not that he's convicted or he's acquitted.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说他被定罪或被判无罪。

sentences.en: It's just they want to look at how he answers a variety of questions, not just whether or not he committed this singular act of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想看看他如何回答各种各样的问题，而不仅仅是判断他是否实施了这一起性侵行为。

sentences.en: And what do you anticipate this looking like, this job interview?
sentences.zh: 你预计这场工作面试会是什么样子的？

sentences.en: Anticipate Democrats trying to poke holes in Judge Kavanaugh's truthfulness by bringing up accounts that have come forward in recent days.
sentences.zh: 预计民主党人会通过提出最近几天浮出水面的说法，来动摇卡瓦诺法官的诚实度。

sentences.en: For instance, Judge Kavanaugh has said on Fox News that he was a regular high school boy.
sentences.zh: 例如，卡瓦诺法官在福克斯新闻上说，他曾是一个规矩的高中男孩。

sentences.en: He did his community service projects and he played sports and he studied.
sentences.zh: 他做过社区服务项目，踢过体育，也学习过。

sentences.en: And that really does not comport with some other accounts, notably that of his Yale freshman roommate who said
sentences.zh: 这与一些其他的说法确实不符，特别是他耶鲁大一室友的说法，那个人说

sentences.en: that Judge Kavanaugh was normally reserved, but that he was a notably heavy drinker, even by the standards
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺法官平时比较内向，但他酒量极大，甚至以那个时代的标准

sentences.en: of that time, and that he became belligerent and aggressive when he was very drunk.
sentences.zh: 来看也是如此，而且他喝大酒后会变得好斗和具有攻击性。

sentences.en: Democrats are likely to bring in Judge Kavanaugh's high school yearbook, where he talks about himself as being treasurer of the
sentences.zh: 民主党人可能会拿出卡瓦诺法官的高中毕业纪念册，他在其中自称是

sentences.en: Keg Club.
sentences.zh: 啤酒俱乐部的财务主管。

sentences.en: And also he listed himself as a member of the Renate Alumni Club.
sentences.zh: 他还将自己列为雷娜特校友俱乐部的成员。

sentences.en: Renate was a woman who apparently was being made fun of by boys in Judge Kavanaugh's high school who were supposedly boasting of
sentences.zh: 雷娜特是一个据信遭到卡瓦诺法官高中男生嘲笑的女性，这些男生当时据称在吹嘘

sentences.en: their sexual conqueSt. When she found out about this through a New York Times story, it was very humiliating for her.
sentences.zh: 他们的性征服。当她通过《纽约时报》的一篇报道发现这件事时，她感到非常羞辱。

sentences.en: And it certainly doesn't speak to the kind of character that you would want in somebody who's sitting on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 这绝对无法体现出人们对最高法院大法官所期望的品格。

sentences.en: And in this model, Kavanaugh is the one, of course, who's applying for the job.
sentences.zh: 在这种模式下，卡瓦诺当然是那个申请工作的人。

sentences.en: So I imagine Democratic senators will focus mostly on him rather than his accuser, Dr. Blasey Ford, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我想民主党参议员会把重点放在他身上，而不是他的指控者布拉西·福特博士，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, they will question Christine Blasey Ford, and she will, in fact, testify firSt. But I would expect them to be very gentle with her and very respectful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们会盘问克里斯汀·布拉西·福特，事实上她也会第一个作证。但我预计他们对她会非常温和且非常尊重。

sentences.en: They'll ask her to tell her story.
sentences.zh: 他们会请她讲述她的故事。

sentences.en: We know that she said it really stuck with her.
sentences.zh: 我们知道她说过这深深地印在她的脑海里。

sentences.en: It was a defining moment in her young life.
sentences.zh: 这是她年轻生活中具有决定性的一刻。

sentences.en: She sought therapy over it, wasn't able to have comfortable relationships with men for four or five years after.
sentences.zh: 她为此寻求了心理治疗，此后四五年都无法与男性建立舒适的关系。

sentences.en: That's really had a lasting imprint on her life.
sentences.zh: 这确实在她的生命中留下了持久的印记。

sentences.en: And I'm sure Democrats will draw her out on that as well.
sentences.zh: 我确信民主党人也会引导她讲述这方面的内容。

sentences.en: And how does gently allowing her to tell her story fit into the strategy of Democrats to kind of disqualify him in the job interview?
sentences.zh: 那么，温和地允许她讲述自己的故事，是如何契合民主党人在工作面试中取消其资格的战略的呢？

sentences.en: Well, she needs to be seen as credible.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她必须被视为具有可信度。

sentences.en: She needs to be seen as somebody who is not motivated by a desire to deny Brett Kavanaugh a seat on the Supreme Court, but rather as a citizen who simply
sentences.zh: 她必须被视为一个不是出于剥夺布特·卡瓦诺最高法院席位的愿望，而是作为一个公民，仅仅

sentences.en: felt she had a story to tell, felt it was her civic duty to inform senators about what she knew, and was coming forward for that reason.
sentences.zh: 觉得自己有一个故事要讲，觉得自己有公民责任向参议员告知她所了解的情况，并出于这个原因挺身而出的人。

sentences.en: And I would also expect, Michael, that we will hear questions from Democrats about why she came forward.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我也预计我们会听到民主党人提出关于她为什么站出来的问题。

sentences.en: What was the process?
sentences.zh: 整个过程是怎样的？

sentences.en: Did she want to remain confidential?
sentences.zh: 她曾希望保持匿名吗？

sentences.en: Why is that important?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: Because she's a more powerful witness.
sentences.zh: 因为她是一个更有分量的证人。

sentences.en: If people understand that she never wanted to go public in the first place, she was kind of forced to when details of her letter started leaking out and her identity leaked out.
sentences.zh: 如果人们了解到她一开始根本不想公开，她是在她的信件细节开始泄露且她的身份泄露时才被迫公开的。

sentences.en: And she heard things that were being said about her that she felt were inaccurate.
sentences.zh: 并且她听到了关于她的那些她认为不准确的言论。

sentences.en: Reporters were showing up on her door.
sentences.zh: 记者们出现在她的家门口。

sentences.en: And so she felt compelled at that point to go public.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候她感到不得不公开。

sentences.en: But it was never her intent.
sentences.zh: 但这从来不是她的意图。

sentences.en: Do we know how Dr. Blasey Ford is preparing for this hearing today and for her part in this job interview?
sentences.zh: 我们知道布拉西·福特博士是如何为今天的这场听证会以及她在这次工作面试中的角色做准备的吗？

sentences.en: In a word?
sentences.zh: 简而言之？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: If that were being made public in any way, I would know.
sentences.zh: 如果这些以任何方式被公之于众，我就会知道。

sentences.en: But her lawyers are keeping such a tight hold.
sentences.zh: 但她的律师们防范得太严了。

sentences.en: We don't know where she's preparing.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道她在哪里做准备。

sentences.en: We don't know where she's staying.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道她住在哪里。

sentences.en: I've tried to find out what is she wearing or even any small detail.
sentences.zh: 我曾试图打听她穿什么衣服，甚至是任何微小的细节。

sentences.en: And we are getting radio silence on that.
sentences.zh: 而我们得到的可以说是万籁俱寂。

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: And what about the prosecutor, the outside lawyer that Republicans have hired and plan to ask to question both Ford and Kavanaugh on their behalf?
sentences.zh: 那么那位检察官呢，也就是共和党人雇佣并计划请来代表他们盘问福特和卡瓦诺的外部律师？

sentences.en: How can we expect the Democrats to interact with her?
sentences.zh: 我们能预料民主党人会如何与她互动吗？

sentences.en: You know, my experts really will not interact with her at all.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的专家们其实根本不会与她互动。

sentences.en: I don't know if they'll try to contradict her or try to jump in as they might in an ordinary situation where one of their Republican colleagues was speaking up.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否会试图反驳她，或者像在正常情况下他们的共和党同僚发言时那样试图插话。

sentences.en: I think that will be interesting to see.
sentences.zh: 我想这会很值得一看。

sentences.en: So in a very real way, this concept of a trial and job interview will unfold simultaneously,
sentences.zh: 所以在非常真实的意义上，审判和工作面试的概念将同时展开，

sentences.en: but not really overlap other than that they are occurring in the same room and they are directed at the same two people, Kavanaugh and Ford.
sentences.zh: 但除了它们发生在同一个房间内且针对同样的两个人——卡瓦诺和福特之外，并没有真正的重叠。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that may feel really strange.
sentences.zh: 这可能会感觉非常奇怪。

sentences.en: Well, it may feel really strange because it is really strange.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可能会感觉非常奇怪，因为它本来就非常奇怪。

sentences.en: This is not how things are done in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 参议院做事从来不是这样的。

sentences.en: You know, first of all, senators like to talk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，首先，参议员们喜欢说话。

sentences.en: So the notion that Republicans would cede their time to a prosecutor, to a third party, is highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 因此，共和党人将他们的时间让给检察官、让给第三方这种做法是非常不寻常的。

sentences.en: And we don't really know how it's going to play out.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道事情会如何发展。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Well, what will make for a successful version of this job interview for Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于民主党人来说，怎样才算是一次成功的工作面试？

sentences.en: At the end of tomorrow, it feels like it's clear what a successful version of this will be for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 到明天结束时，对于共和党人来说，怎样才算成功似乎很明确。

sentences.en: They will simply have to not prove that Judge Kavanaugh did anything to Dr.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要不用去证明卡瓦诺法官对德·

sentences.en: Blasey Ford.
sentences.zh: 布拉西·福特做过什么。

sentences.en: What does success look like for the Democrats, given the structure that they are pursuing?
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们所追求的结构，民主党人的成功是什么样的？

sentences.en: So I think the Democratic version of success is just raising enough doubts about Judge Kavanaugh
sentences.zh: 所以我想民主党版本的成功，就是对卡瓦诺法官产生足够的质疑，

sentences.en: to sink his nomination, to just plant the seeds in senators' minds that, you know what?
sentences.zh: 从而彻底粉碎他的提名，在参议员心中种下这样的怀疑种子：你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm not so sure about this guy.
sentences.zh: 我对这家伙没那么确信。

sentences.en: Maybe there's a better guy for the job.
sentences.zh: 也许有更适合这份工作的人选。

sentences.en: And that bar would seem to be a lot lower in a job interview, as we've discussed, than in a trial.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所讨论的，在工作面试中，这个门槛似乎比审判中要低得多。

sentences.en: That bar is a lot lower in a job interview.
sentences.zh: 在工作面试中，这个门槛低得多。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Cheryl, we know that Democrats and Republicans have two very different strategies going into this hearing today.
sentences.zh: 那么，谢丽尔，我们知道民主党人和共和党人在进入今天这场听证会时采取了两种截然不同的策略。

sentences.en: If this is a trial, as Republicans think it is, who is the jury?
sentences.zh: 如果这是一场审判，正如共和党人所认为的那样，谁是陪审团？

sentences.en: And if this is a job interview, as Democrats think it is, who ultimately makes the hire?
sentences.zh: 如果这是一场工作面试，正如民主党人所认为的那样，究竟是谁最终决定录用？

sentences.en: Who is the audience here?
sentences.zh: 这里的受众是谁？

sentences.en: Well, it's the same jury or the same group that's making the hire.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是同一个陪审团，或者说是做出录用决定的同一群人。

sentences.en: It's very, very small.
sentences.zh: 这个群体非常非常小。

sentences.en: Really, it's about four or so senators, all Republicans, Jeff Flake of Arizona, Susan Collins
sentences.zh: 实际上，大约只有四名左右的参议员，全都是共和党人，亚利桑那州的杰夫·弗莱克、缅因州的

sentences.en: of Maine, Lisa Murkowski of Alaska, and maybe Dean Heller of Nevada, who are either undecided or who simply haven't said what their decision is.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·柯林斯、阿拉斯加州的丽莎·穆尔科斯基，也许还有内华达州的迪恩·海勒，他们要么尚未决定，要么根本没有表态他们的决定是什么。

sentences.en: And in the end, that's really who both Democrats and Republicans are pitching their strategies towards.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这确实是民主党人和共和党人制定策略的目标所在。

sentences.en: The big question is, will those senators see this as a legal proceeding, or do they view it as a job interview?
sentences.zh: 最大的问题是，这些参议员会将此视为法律程序，还是将其视为工作面试？

sentences.en: And what happens if they view it as a job interview?
sentences.zh: 如果他们将其视为工作面试会发生什么？

sentences.en: And what happens if they view it as a trial?
sentences.zh: 如果他们将其视为审判会发生什么？

sentences.en: So, if they view it as a trial, it's going to be really hard for these allegations to carry great
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他们将其视为审判，这些指控将很难在他们的决策中占据巨大

sentences.en: weight in their decision-making, to influence their decision, because it's impossible to prove them.
sentences.zh: 的分量，很难左右他们的决定，因为这些指控是不可能被证实的。

sentences.en: So, I suppose if they view it as a trial, he gets confirmed.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想如果他们把它当成审判，他就会获得确认。

sentences.en: But if they view it as a job interview,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们把它当成工作面试，

sentences.en: then this all goes into the mix of what kind of character he has, and whether or not he's deserving.
sentences.zh: 那么这一切都会汇入对他的人品如何以及他是否配得上这份工作的综合考量中。

sentences.en: And do they have any doubts about that?
sentences.zh: 他们对此有任何疑虑吗？

sentences.en: Is there something nagging at them that worries them, that makes them feel like, gee, you know what?
sentences.zh: 有什么事情在折磨着他们、让他们感到担忧，让他们觉得，天哪，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I don't feel quite comfortable giving this guy this high-powered job.
sentences.zh: 我把这个位高权重的工作交给这家伙，感觉真有点不太踏实。

sentences.en: And in the end, maybe those senators will vote no.
sentences.zh: 到头来，也许这些参议员会投反对票。

sentences.en: And we'll be looking at a new
sentences.zh: 我们不久就会看到一个新的

sentences.en: Supreme Court nominee before long.
sentences.zh: 最高法院大法官提名人。

sentences.en: Cheryl, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 谢丽尔，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The Senate Judiciary Committee will begin its questioning of Dr. Blasey and Judge Kavanaugh at 10 o'clock this morning.
sentences.zh: 参议院司法委员会将于今天上午10点开始对布拉西博士和卡瓦诺法官进行质询。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, a third woman accused Judge Kavanaugh of sexual misconduct during high school in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 周三，第三名女性指控卡瓦诺法官在20世纪80年代的高中时期有不当性行为。

sentences.en: The woman,
sentences.zh: 这名女性

sentences.en: Julie Swetnick, said she saw Kavanaugh at parties where women were verbally abused, inappropriately touched, and at times gang-raped, and that Kavanaugh himself
sentences.zh: 朱莉·斯威特尼克说，她看到卡瓦诺出现在一些派对上，在那些派对上女性遭到言语虐待、不当抚摸，有时甚至被轮奸，卡瓦诺本人

sentences.en: participated in some of the misconduct.
sentences.zh: 也参与了部分不当行为。

sentences.en: A claim Kavanaugh flatly denied.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺对此予以断然否认。

sentences.en: We've had a great three days at the United Nations in New York.
sentences.zh: 我们在纽约联合国总部度过了非常棒的三天。

sentences.en: A few hours later, during a news conference at the United Nations,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，在联合国的一次新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: President Trump was asked how the many accusations of sexual misconduct against himself have influenced his view of those against Judge Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统被问到，他自己面对的许多关于性骚扰的指控，是如何影响他对针对卡瓦诺法官的指控的看法的。

sentences.en: Well, it does impact my opinion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这确实影响了我的看法。

sentences.en: You know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because I've had a lot of false charges made against me.
sentences.zh: 因为我曾被很多虚假指控针对过。

sentences.en: I'm a very famous person, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我是一个非常有名的人。

sentences.en: I've been a famous person for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我出名已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: But I've had a lot of false charges made against me, really false charges.
sentences.zh: 但我确实被诬告过很多次，全都是假指控。

sentences.en: I know friends that have had false charges.
sentences.zh: 我认识的朋友也有被诬告的经历。

sentences.en: People want fame, they want money, they want whatever.
sentences.zh: 人们为了名气，为了金钱，为了各种东西。

sentences.en: Under questioning from reporters, Trump continued to vigorously defend Kavanaugh, but said he was open to withdrawing the nomination, depending on what happens at today's hearing.
sentences.zh: 在记者的追问下，特朗普继续极力为主张卡瓦诺辩护，但也表示，取决于今天听证会的结果，他对撤回提名持开放态度。

sentences.en: It sounds like what you're saying is there is a situation, there is a scenario under which you would withdraw Brett Kavanaugh's nomination.
sentences.zh: 听起来你的意思是说，存在一种情况，存在一种可能，你会撤回对布雷特·卡瓦诺的提名。

sentences.en: Is that correct?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: If I thought he was guilty of something like this, yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 如果我认为他真的做过这种事，那当然会。

sentences.en: And you will wait until tomorrow to make up your mind?
sentences.zh: 你要等到明天再做决定吗？

sentences.en: I want to watch.
sentences.zh: 我想看看。

sentences.en: I want to see.
sentences.zh: 我想观察一下。

sentences.en: I hope I can watch.
sentences.zh: 希望我能看到。

sentences.en: Later on Wednesday night, yet another accuser emerged, claiming in an anonymous letter to a
sentences.zh: 周三晚些时候，又出现了一名指控者，她在给一位

sentences.en: Republican senator that Kavanaugh had drunkenly and aggressively pushed a woman he was dating against a wall after they had left a bar in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员的匿名信中声称，在20世纪90年代的一天，卡瓦诺在离开一家酒吧后，醉醺醺且极具攻击性地把一个跟他约会的女人推到了墙上。

sentences.en: Kavanaugh denies the allegation.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺否认了这一指控。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，了解如何让你的客人们有宾至如归的感觉。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你常用的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
